name: seongho-ops
description: Guides production changes through TDD, routes operational work to purpose-built local CLIs, opens protected Vercel previews, and packages Seongho's port cleanup utility.

interface.shortDescription: Guide code changes with TDD, route operational CLI work, open protected previews, and provide k.
interface.longDescription: Seongho Ops provides an implicitly invocable test-driven development skill for features, bug fixes, refactors, and behavior changes without modifying global instructions. It also selects the correct authenticated local CLI for operational work, securely opens protected Vercel previews in the Codex browser, and bundles the k command for force-stopping processes that own explicitly requested local ports.
defaultPrompt: Use the correct local CLI for this operational task.
Diagnose this CLI authentication failure safely.
Open this protected Vercel preview in the Codex browser.
Free this local port with the bundled k command.
Implement this code change with test-driven development.
